if n < 2 then false
else
  let rec is_prime' (m: Nat) (d: Nat): Bool :=
    if d * d > m then true
    else if m % d = 0 then false
    else is_prime' m (d + 1)
  is_prime' n 2
[END]

lemma is_prime'_base_case
(n: Nat)
: is_prime'.loop n 2 = true ↔ 2 ≤ n ∧ ¬ (∃ k, 2 ≤ k ∧ k < n ∧ n % k = 0) :=
by
induction' n generalizing d
